image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a tiger beetle on a sandy, pebbled surface. The beetle has a metallic coppery-bronze exoskeleton with distinct pale cream-colored markings on its elytra. It features long, slender legs, prominent compound eyes, and very long, thin antennae extending backward.
